title: Localization of the right rational composition route
statement: theorem canonicalRationalPullbackTensorComposition_right_localization {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ X) [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] [hZ : ∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)] (M N : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E Y) : HEq ((pullbackTensorRationalComposition l E f h ((rationalDerivedTensor l E Y).obj (M,N))).hom ≫ (rationalDerivedPullback l E h).map (canonicalRationalPullbackTensor l E f M N).hom ≫ (canonicalRationalPullbackTensor l E h ((rationalDerivedPullback l E f).obj M) ((rationalDerivedPullback l E f).obj N)).hom) ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E Z).map ((pullbackTensorIntegralComposition l E f h).hom.app ((constructibleIntegralTensor l E Y).obj (M.obj,N.obj)) ≫ (constructibleIntegralPullback l E h).map (canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l E f M.obj N.obj).hom ≫ (canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l E h ((constructibleIntegralPullback l E f).obj M.obj) ((constructibleIntegralPullback l E f).obj N.obj)).hom))

theorem canonicalRationalPullbackTensorComposition_right_localization {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ X)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [hZ : ∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    (M N : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E Y) :
    HEq
      ((pullbackTensorRationalComposition l E f h
          ((rationalDerivedTensor l E Y).obj (M,N))).hom ≫
        (rationalDerivedPullback l E h).map
          (canonicalRationalPullbackTensor l E f M N).hom ≫
        (canonicalRationalPullbackTensor l E h
          ((rationalDerivedPullback l E f).obj M)
          ((rationalDerivedPullback l E f).obj N)).hom)
      ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E Z).map
        ((pullbackTensorIntegralComposition l E f h).hom.app
            ((constructibleIntegralTensor l E Y).obj (M.obj,N.obj)) ≫
          (constructibleIntegralPullback l E h).map
            (canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l E f M.obj N.obj).hom ≫
          (canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l E h
            ((constructibleIntegralPullback l E f).obj M.obj)
            ((constructibleIntegralPullback l E f).obj N.obj)).hom))
